cards.front: Recall a key point about Production & Distribution
cards.back: Media production involves three stages: pre-production (planning, scripting, storyboarding, casting, financing), production (filming, recording, creating), and post-production (editing, effects, sound mixing, grading).

cards.front: Recall a key point about Production & Distribution
cards.back: Financing: media products are funded through various models — studio investment, licence fee (BBC), advertising, subscription, crowdfunding, and government grants.

cards.front: Recall a key point about Production & Distribution
cards.back: Distribution is how media products reach audiences — cinema release, broadcast, streaming, physical media, print, and digital download. Each channel has different economics and audience reach.

cards.front: Recall a key point about Production & Distribution
cards.back: Marketing strategies include: trailers, posters, social media campaigns, press junkets, premiere events, viral marketing, influencer partnerships, and merchandising.

cards.front: Recall a key point about Production & Distribution
cards.back: The theatrical window: traditionally, films had an exclusive cinema release before becoming available on other platforms. Streaming has shortened or eliminated this window.

cards.front: Recall a key point about Production & Distribution
cards.back: Streaming distribution: Netflix, Amazon Prime, and Disney+ distribute content globally, bypassing traditional cinema and broadcast channels. This has transformed distribution economics.

cards.front: Recall a key point about Production & Distribution
cards.back: Day-and-date release: releasing a film in cinemas and on streaming simultaneously. This expands access but reduces cinema exclusivity and has been controversial with filmmakers.

cards.front: Recall a key point about Production & Distribution
cards.back: Digital production: technology has democratised production — smartphones, affordable editing software, and online distribution enable anyone to create professional-quality media.

cards.front: Recall a key point about Production & Distribution
cards.back: Synergy in distribution: conglomerates use cross-promotion across their properties — e.g. a Marvel film promoted on Disney TV channels, streaming service, and merchandise.

cards.front: Recall a key point about Production & Distribution
cards.back: Global distribution: major media products are designed for global audiences, with international marketing campaigns and content that crosses cultural boundaries.

cards.front: Recall a key point about Production & Distribution
cards.back: Independent distribution: smaller films and media products rely on film festivals, limited theatrical releases, and online platforms to reach audiences without studio marketing budgets.

cards.front: Recall a key point about Production & Distribution
cards.back: Impact of COVID-19: the pandemic accelerated the shift to streaming, closed many cinemas, and demonstrated the resilience of digital distribution models.

cards.front: What should you know about media studies exam tips — production & distribution?
cards.back: 1. For Production & Distribution, use media terminology precisely (e.g. connotation, denotation, representation, ideology) 2. Always analyse how media language creates meaning for specific audiences 3. Reference specific examples from set products to support your analysis 4. When evaluating Production & Distribution, consider the role of media industries and cultural contexts 5. For extended answers, debate different interpretations before reaching your own
Analyse how digital technology has changed the production and distribution of media products. [15 marks]

AO1 (Knowledge & Understanding): Demonstrate knowledge and understanding of production & distribution, including key concepts, theories, and media contexts. AO2 (Analysis & Evaluation): Analyse and evaluate production & distribution using relevant theories and frameworks. Consider different perspectives and reach reasoned conclusions. AO3 (Create): Apply understanding of production & distribution
